name: Segmented Control
summary: Native radio-backed single-choice field with a visible group label, compact segmented presentation, form lifecycle ownership, and independent validation styling.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Native fieldset that labels and groups one mutually exclusive choice.

anatomy.name: legend
anatomy.description: Visible native legend naming the complete choice group.

anatomy.name: requiredIndicator
anatomy.description: Decorative asterisk optically centered with the group legend when one segment is required.

anatomy.name: options
anatomy.description: Compact visual surface containing the authored radio options.

anatomy.name: input
anatomy.description: Native radio input for the segment.

states.name: default
states.description: Available group with one current native value.

states.name: hover
states.description: Pointer hover state on a segment label.

states.name: focusVisible
states.description: Outer group ring and inner focused-option indicator.

states.name: groupDisabled
states.description: Native fieldset disables every contained option.

states.name: optionDisabled
states.description: One authored option is unavailable while the group remains usable.

states.name: requiredInvalid
states.description: No value is selected in a native required radio group; validation styling remains an independent choice.

behavior.name: nativeRadioGroup
behavior.description: Native fieldset, legend, and same-name radios own grouping, naming, mutual exclusion, validity, and option state without redundant ARIA roles.

behavior.name: selectionState
behavior.description: Visual selected state must stay synchronized with the native radio checked value.

behavior.name: keyboardNavigation
behavior.description: The native radio group owns Tab entry/exit, directional selection, wrapping, and Space activation.

behavior.name: formLifecycle
behavior.description: The checked native radio owns emitted events, FormData, constraint validation, and reset to authored checkedness.

behavior.name: controlledUncontrolled
behavior.description: Static checkedness is the uncontrolled default; controlled adapters synchronize one group value rather than independent item booleans.

properties.name: variant
properties.description: Validation presentation independent from the selected option.

properties.name: groupLabel
properties.description: Visible label naming the complete single-choice group.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Visible label for an individual segment.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Stable submitted value for an individual segment.

properties.name: checked
properties.description: Native selected state for an individual segment.

properties.name: required
properties.description: Requires one option before native form submission and shows the standardized decorative marker once on the group legend.

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Makes the complete choice group unavailable through native fieldset propagation.

properties.name: optionDisabled
properties.description: Makes one authored segment unavailable while preserving the rest of the group.

properties.name: describedBy
properties.description: Id reference for group help or validation feedback.

accessibility: Use a native fieldset, visible legend, and same-name radio inputs for mutually exclusive segmented choices.
Keep checked state synchronized with the visible selected segment.
Let native radios own Arrow and Space behavior, form submission, constraint validation, and reset.
Do not use Segmented Control as a tablist, multi-select toggle group, or toolbar of independent actions.
Keep option labels concise and provide text rather than icons alone.

web.notes: Implemented by a native fieldset/legend, same-name radios, and class composition in components/css/forms.css; no runtime enhancer is required.

shopify.notes: Shopify Liquid can render radio-backed segmented controls with the same class contract.
